Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Cinemagic Media Inc. operates a video and media store specializing in the rental and sale of a wide variety of films, documentaries, and television series, including both physical copies and digital downloads. The store features a curated selection of classic and contemporary titles, along with a collection of specialty films not commonly found in mainstream outlets. Our operations are supported by a comprehensive inventory management system and a strong focus on customer service. We have implemented robust security measures, including a professionally monitored alarm system and security cameras, to safeguard our assets and ensure a safe shopping environment for customers. Additionally, we conduct regular employee training sessions to promote safety and loss prevention practices. We prioritize compliance with all regulations, ensuring that all media products offered for rent or sale are licensed and legitimate, thus avoiding exposure to any intellectual property infringement.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, Cinemagic Media Inc. experienced a theft incident where 20 DVDs valued at $400 were stolen from the store. The incident was reported to local authorities, and the case is currently under investigation. The status is pending, with a claim filed for recovery of the losses. Total loss amount reported: $400.
